metadata.summary: Magomed Magomedov maintained his perfect fight record in his ONE Championship debut, earning a split-decision victory over Lucas Gabriel in their lightweight MMA matchup on ONE Fight Night 49.
metadata.content: ONE Championship Fight Night 49: Magomed Magomedov beats Lucas Gabriel to maintain perfect record | MMA News | Sky Sports Skip to main content ONE Championship Fight Night 49: Magomed Magomedov beats Lucas Gabriel to maintain perfect record Magomed Magomedov overcomes late surge from Lucas Gabriel to secure split-decision victory on ONE Championship debut; the 31-year-old could next be in contention for a shot at the ONE lightweight MMA world title against newly-crowned champion Tye Ruotolo Saturday 7 November 2026 11:13, UK Image: Magomed Magomedov has a perfect 16-0 record after winning on his ONE Championship debut Magomed Magomedov maintained his perfect fight record in his ONE Championship debut, earning a split-decision victory over Lucas Gabriel in their lightweight MMA matchup on ONE Fight Night 49. Magomedov entered the main event at Bangkok's Lumpinee Stadium on Friday night with an unblemished 15-0 record, stepping in with just two weeks' notice after former world title challenger Alibeg Rasulov withdrew due to injury. Gabriel, meanwhile, came in boasting an 11-1 record and an unbeaten run in ONE Championship, coming off a huge three-round victory over former ONE lightweight MMA world champion Ok Rae Yoon. messages.text: What's gone so wrong so quickly at Crystal Palace?

metadata.summary: As Pierre Sage waited to receive the Coupe de France trophy as the victorious manager of RC Lens last May, he turned to his staff and said: "Do you realise where we are?"
metadata.content: Pierre Sage under pressure: How Crystal Palace and last season's Ligue 1 manager of the year are both suffering | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis Pierre Sage under pressure: How Crystal Palace and last season's Ligue 1 manager of the year are both suffering Pierre Sage struggling for results at Selhurst Park after loss of Daniel Munoz and Maxence Lacroix plus injury to Ismaila Sarr - but bigger questions remain; watch Crystal Palace vs Liverpool live on Sky Sports Main Event from 12.30pm on Sunday, kick-off 2pm Ron Walker Football Journalist @Ronnabe Saturday 7 November 2026 11:26, UK As Pierre Sage waited to receive the Coupe de France trophy as the victorious manager of RC Lens last May, he turned to his staff and said: "Do you realise where we are?" Sage had just led the club to a first French Cup title in its history while plotting a course to finish second in Ligue 1, its joint-best league position in over two decades - all in his first season in charge. Having managed only 56 professional games prior to joining the club, he had become the rising star of French football almost overnight. Less than six months on, the 47-year-old may be glad he took that moment to embrace the good times.
